plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Public Health Track, Public Health, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/public-health-public-health-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Public Health Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 1 = 'See approved General Education list of the AA/AS Degree', 2 = 'See program recommendations or requirements', 3 = 'If transferring to UNR BS Public Health choose electives from UNR with prefixes found in Section IV.B', 4 = 'Recommend PHIL 210 - World Religions for students transferring to UNR' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. PBH 234 substitutes for PBH 334 at UNR; NUTR 223 fulfills 3 units of additional college credits towards science. Satisfies the lower-division major requirements toward the UNR BS in Public Health. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
